lastCompletedStory.title: Wire phase:planning detection into the sidecar outer loop to invoke runPlanPhase

nextStoryContext: US-002 wired the plan-phase detection into the sidecar outer loop. Key changes: (1) RunSidecarLoopOptions gained two optional deps: readLoopPhaseFn?: () => LoopPhase | undefined and runPlanPhaseFn?: () => void | Promise<void>. (2) runSidecarLoop checks readLoopPhaseFn() before the active!==true idle branch: when phase==='planning' and runPlanPhaseFn is present, calls runPlanPhaseFn() then sleeps+continues (mutually exclusive with idle and implement paths). (3) sidecar.ts added makeReadLoopPhase (exported), makeReadActive is now exported, makeProductionPlanPhaseFn factory wires runPlanPhase with all deps (loopSpawnFn, isPaneAlive, preflightSpawnFn, paneCountMutexFn, selectIssueFn, makeReadPlanVerdict, readPlannerReportFn, randomUUID), and buildPlanPhaseDeps extracts those two deps to keep buildSidecarLoopDeps under biome complexity limit. (4) file-size-budget.json raised for 5 files (3 changed by this story + 2 pre-existing from US-001). All 2581 tests pass. The next story (US-003) should use this injectable seam to complete the post-audit action (commit branch, flip active) and any additional plan-phase lifecycle handling.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 only touches cam-cli internals (loop.ts, sidecar.ts) and Node.js built-ins (node:crypto randomUUID, node:child_process spawnSync). No external library exercised.
